# Decisions (Acme Notes API S21)

- t02-choose-api-version: Build against API version v1 with base path AX-18174 (error format AX-29401). Relies on facts: style_guide.api_version = v1, api.base_path = AX-18174, api.error_format = AX-29401. The repo/api.py code (re-read during t02) agrees with the recorded facts, so no conflict to resolve.
- t02-choose-api-version (update, adopt-v2): Adopt API version v2, superseding the earlier v1 choice above. Relies on fact: style_guide.api_version = v2 [source: acme-docs/06_api_style_guide_v2.md]. It governs over style_guide.api_version = v1 because the v2 guide is newer and the v1 guide is withdrawn. Follow-up: t12-update-endpoints-for-v2.
- t05-choose-auth: Use the security team's scheme for user traffic: JWT bearer tokens, RS256, 15-minute expiry. Relies on facts: security.auth_method = JWT bearer tokens, signed with RS256, issued by the Acme identity provider; expire after 15 minutes, and customer.auth_method = long-lived API key in an `X-Api-Key` header. The two conflict; security.auth_method governs because it is the security team's requirement and long-lived keys weaken it. The customer's request is not adopted for user traffic; it is deferred as a separate follow-up (a scoped, revocable machine-to-machine credential for Globex, to be reviewed with the security team) rather than silently implemented. Code settings (repo/auth.py agrees with facts): auth.token_ttl = AX-70256, auth.key_header = AX-73094.
- t09-review-spec: REJECT the t07 crud-spec until its header is corrected from API v1 to API v2. Relies on facts: style_guide.api_version = v2 (supersedes v1; v1 guide withdrawn, see t02 adopt-v2 decision), security.auth_method = JWT bearer tokens, RS256, 15 minutes (spec matches, see t05-choose-auth), infra.database = PostgreSQL 16 (spec matches), and the current code values api.base_path = AX-18174, auth.token_ttl = AX-62079 (supersedes AX-70256), db.engine = AX-14196, all re-read from repo/.
- t13-reuse-billing-cycle: Reuse the S07 billing cycle "quarterly, invoiced on day 7" (found in history/logs/researcher.jsonl, Bolt Billing API S07 billing_cycle) and the S13 API-key header "X-Core-Key" (found in history/logs/planner.jsonl, Acme Notes API S13 auth_method). Each sprint's record is scoped to that sprint, so the S07/S13 entries are the ones that govern for this reuse, not other sprints' values. Code settings from repo/billing.py: billing.cycle = AX-86101, billing.currency = AX-86464. Note: the S13 header is a reused historical value only; it does not override the t05-choose-auth decision (JWT bearer for user traffic).
